claims.explanation: Triptolide covalently inhibits XPB/TFIIH, causing RNA polymerase II degradation and blocking transcription, and it also inhibits NF-κB/RELA. Selective killing is enriched in lines with mutations that drive high transcriptional output and NF-κB activation (BRAF, PTEN, NF1, NF2, SF3B1, STK11, PIK3CA), suggesting these pathways create dependency on RNAPII and NF-κB. Lines with RAS mutations or low NF-κB dependency are less affected.
